description: Sample and hold built on a stack: each push samples the input and puts it on top of the pile, each pop throws the top one away, and the output carries whatever is on top

inputs.text: A rising edge throws away the value on top of the stack, and it changes nothing while the stack is empty
A rising edge samples In and pushes that voltage onto the stack; it is ignored once seven values are held, although the maker's README describes eight frames
The voltage that is sampled at the moment Push fires; at every other moment it is ignored

outputs.text: The value on top of the stack, or 0V while the stack is empty
